forcing: WorldClim2.1 5arcmin 1970–2000 monthly temperature, bilinear at source crop-area-weighted regional centroid; centroid is not a regional average
eligibility: Unique source Data.ID; Wheat/Barley; no Exclude qualifier; valid medians/duration, Nation.code, finite centroid. All four WorldClim interpolation corners must be valid in every month; retain all QC exclusions.

split.rule: sha256(cereal-phenology-v1: + Nation.code) integer modulo 5 == 0 is evaluation; all other countries training
split.prior_inspection: Full Sacks duration/exposure diagnostics already inspected. This is a prospective country-separated evaluation, not an untouched dataset or Earth climate holdout. Neighboring countries and regional records can remain correlated.

interpolation: Periodic linear interpolation of monthly means at actual Gregorian month centers to daily centers in a 365-day climatology; no daily weather reconstructed
conditioning: Sowing midpoint is prescribed from observed calendars; predict physiological maturity elapsed days. No sowing date, absolute yield, frost survival, harvest operation or ancient population inferred.

source.implementation: Independent implementation of paper mathematics; reference source used to resolve PVD<=10 and PHU lower-bound conventions, no upstream C code imported

reference_parameters.chilling_status: Explicit fixed proxy within published 0–60-day domain, not a claimed LPJmL default or reproduction of endogenous equation77

tuning.scope: One global scale, one global winter chilling requirement; crop/region-specific fitting prohibited. Scaled heat requirements clipped to published cultivar ranges.
tuning.objective: Equal-country mean of record absolute maturity-duration error; no maturity within365 supplied days costs365days; all eligible records stay in denominator
tuning.tiebreak: distance from scale1, then chilling45, then numerical values

freeze: Commit selected global parameters and training results before any evaluation-country maturity score. Evaluate selected parameters once; report all fixed comparators and failed maturity.
